title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
The patient presents today for follow-up regarding peripheral neuropathy.

History of Present Illness
The patient has a history of type 1 diabetes mellitus and reports ongoing numbness and tingling in his extremities. The provider reviewed the current neuropathy symptoms and explicitly stated that the current polyneuropathy is unrelated to diabetes. The patient continues to manage his type 1 diabetes using long-term insulin.

Medication List
Insulin (long-term use)

Exam
Physical exam is largely unremarkable apart from documented peripheral neuropathy findings.

Assessment
1. Type 1 diabetes mellitus: Managed with insulin.
2. Polyneuropathy: Status post evaluation; determined to be unrelated to diabetes.

Plan
Continue current regimen of insulin for management of type 1 diabetes. Follow up as planned. Further workup for the polyneuropathy, confirming it is not due to diabetes, remains ongoing.
explanations: The provider states the polyneuropathy is not diabetic: code each separately.
Polyneuropathy not due to diabetes is coded separately (G62.9 when no cause is specified).
Do not assign Z79.4 for type 1 diabetes; insulin use is inherent.

distractors.why: Provider documentation of no link overrides the presumption.
The polyneuropathy still needs its own code.
Z79.4 is not assigned for type 1 diabetes.
